limitations: Finite local repeated cohorts; not a deployment acceptance or universal performance claim.
First packed-pressure pairs include CPU profiles; other pairs do not. Both versions use the same profile policy.
Pinned four one-slot peers remove normal four-slot admission choice; mixed latency therefore needs investigation beyond assuming selection is its cause.
CPU-role affinity controls allowed cores, not per-goroutine placement or clock/power/thermal state.
Warning logs and synthetic tests do not prove the external cause of France delivery interruptions.
